content:
Maya Patel: quick design review 1 — pushed a tiny prototype for a compact invoke timeline + inline schema quick-insert in the Playground. want rapid feedback before i hand to eng.
Sam Kim: saw it, nice compacting. my concern: function defs get a bit hidden when collapsed. discoverability feels lower.
Maya Patel: noted. current pattern: a single-line pill that reads `3 tools B7 edit` which expands on hover/tap. accessibility: needs keyboard focus and aria-expanded state.
Leo Huang: keyboard expand is straightforward. support Enter and Space on the pill. use `aria-controls` pointing to the expanded panel id.
Olivia Ruiz: copy nit: `3 tools B7 edit` looks like a counter + action. maybe `3 function definitions` or simply `3 functions`. short label should be clear.
Priya Nair: prefer `3 functions` to match SDK naming. show full label in a tooltip on small screens where truncation happens.
Sam Kim: run-history behavior question: when opening a run, do we show full schema JSON or a summary + diff? prototype currently shows full schema which is noisy for long defs.
Maya Patel: proposal: show summary (name + arg list + return type) by default, with a collapsible `View full schema` for the blob. also add a compact diff view when defs changed between runs.
Leo Huang: for diffs, use a micro-summary bar with counts like `+1 arg, -0 props, changed types` rather than full patch. users want the headline not the full patch usually.
playground-bot: New prototype uploaded: https://playground.internal/r/compact-invoke-2026
Olivia Ruiz: visual affordance: when a tool call fails due to schema mismatch we currently underline the output in red. it's easy to miss. suggest inline toast anchored to the invocation row: `Tool call failed E280  schema mismatch. View suggested fix` linking to quick-edit.
Sam Kim: +1. Also show failing param name inline so devs can click to jump to the function def editor.
Priya Nair: a11y: pill color contrast is low on bright themes. target 4.5:1 for normal text. expand chevron should be `aria-hidden=\"true\"` and the button needs an accessible label `Toggle function definitions`.
Maya Patel: will update tokens. small quick-insert modal snippet in the prototype (inserts skeleton defs):

```json
{
  "name": "search_documents",
  "description": "Search internal docs",
  "parameters": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "query": {"type": "string"},
      "limit": {"type": "integer", "default": 5}
    },
    "required": ["query"]
  }
}
```

Sam Kim: modal looks good. add shortcuts: Cmd+K to open quick-insert, Shift+Enter to accept with defaults.
Leo Huang: also support Esc to close and Ctrl+Enter to insert but keep modal open for rapid multiple inserts.
Olivia Ruiz: run-history filter copy: `Show only tool-calls` -> `Filter: tool calls`. add SR-only label: `Filter run history to only show tool calls`.
Priya Nair: voiceover: when tabbing into a collapsed run item it reads `Run at 11:32 collapsed`. update to: `Run at 11:32, 2 tool calls, collapsed` to provide context.
Maya Patel: want to add a micro-CTA in run header: `Re-run with latest defs` which revalidates and highlights schema mismatches inline.
Sam Kim: mobile note: compact timeline becomes accordion. watch for swipe-to-dismiss conflicts with horizontal token scrolling in outputs.
Leo Huang: add larger hit-area padding to avoid accidental swipes. ensure pinch-to-zoom doesn't collapse timeline.
Maya Patel: telemetry ask: instrument `quick-insert.open`, `quick-insert.insert`, `run-history.expand`, `schema-preview.view-diff` events to measure discoverability.
playground-bot: Suggested telemetry schema: `{event:string, ts:number, user_id:string, extra:object}` E28094 ensure no PII.
Priya Nair: add `role=\"status\"` live region for toasts so screen readers announce schema mismatch immediately.
Olivia Ruiz: make `Re-run with latest defs` a secondary button so it doesn't draw too much attention.
Maya Patel: action items: update figma with: pill label adjustments, keyboard interactions (Enter/Space/Esc/Ctrl+Enter), compact diff micro-summary, inline toast with jump-to-def link, a11y tokens updates, telemetry events. I'll ship a follow-up build.
Sam Kim: i'll queue the a11y keyboard flow tests.
Leo Huang: i'll draft telemetry PR and add event names + schemas.
Priya Nair: will run VoiceOver + NVDA sanity once build is live.
Maya Patel: :thumbsup:
